titles.romaji: Kateikyoushi Hitman REBORN! Vongole Family Sou Toujou! Vongole Shiki Shuugakuryokou, Kuru!!
titles.english: REBORN!: Here Comes a Vongola Family-Style School Trip!
titles.native: 家庭教師ヒットマンREBORN! ボンゴレファミリー総登場! ボンゴレ式修学旅行、来る!!

description: Initially an internet-only stand-alone special episode of Katekyo Hitman Reborn! shown on the Shounen-Jump website, where the main characters go to various tourist spots in Japan. It was made available later on DVD in July 2010, adding extra scenes.
